author: Xbox
description:
Mariachi Legends is coming to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Game Pass!
A brutal, combat-driven Metroidvania in pixel art, set in the heart of Mexico.

Play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has sealed a pact with Death herself. With this power, he can transform into La Sombra, an unstoppable entity capable of facing the forces of evil.

Master relentless combat, confront twisted enemies, and uncover the truth behind a darkness spreading across the land.

Mariachi Legends is coming to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC as an Xbox Play Anywhere title.
